subject: PO vs Card / Marketplace interest — procurement timeline & MPA
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@greenline.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenline.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement readiness & draft MPA

Hi Jennifer / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed mutual action plan so we can align procurement and technical reviewers.

Key notes from call:
- Procurement path: primary preference appears to be PO (company card only for pilots < $5k).
- Marketplace: interest in listing on the RedCloud Marketplace for recurring purchasing long-term, but procurement wants to know onboarding and invoicing flow.
- Security & legal: Greenline security will run a short questionnaire (Tom owns); legal wants a draft MSA before their final sign-off.
- Timeline: Greenline targeting production pilot week starting 2026-06-28; procurement wants PO issued 2 weeks before pilot.

Proposed mutual action plan (MPA) — high level:
1) By 2026-05-19: I’ll send a draft MPA + sample SOW and confirm billing options (PO vs card vs marketplace). [Attachment: redwood_mpa_draft.docx]
2) By 2026-05-26: Greenline to return completed security questionnaire + list of required evidence for SOC2/infra (Tom). [Attachment: security_questionnaire.pdf]
3) By 2026-06-09: Legal review complete (both sides) — exchange redlines on MSA/SOW.
4) By 2026-06-14: Finance issues PO (if PO route chosen) or confirms charge card pilot process; marketplace onboarding decision finalized.
5) Week of 2026-06-28: Pilot starts (1-week smoke test)

Questions / clarifications for you now:
- Can you confirm whether Greenline procurement requires three quotes for this tier? That will affect lead time on PO issuance.
- Who is the finance approver for POs (name/email)?
- Any internal procurement portal (Ariba, Coupa) we should prepare for?

I’ve attached the draft MPA and the standard security questionnaire to make it easier for your teams — let me know if you want a short walkthrough with Marissa (our solutions engineer) on Thursday.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_mpa_draft.docx]

From: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@greenline.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenline.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement readiness & draft MPA

Vivek — thanks for the summary, that matches our notes. A few quick answers: 

- Procurement: PO is the default for anything above $2,500. For small pilots we can use a corporate card but need pre-approval from Finance.
- Finance approver: Sara Lind (sara.lind@greenline.com) — I’ve CC’d Tom to ensure she gets the MPA when ready.
- Portal: we use Coupa for PO issuance (we’ll need your vendor form + W9).

We’ll fill out the security questionnaire and return to you by 2026-05-26. Legal prefers to start with your MSA and will do an initial review; they typically take 2–3 weeks for the first pass.

Marketplace: we’re interested in marketplace listing, but procurement wants to understand whether invoicing still flows to our finance (vendor is Redwood) or via the marketplace’s managed billing. Please include a short note in the MPA about marketplace invoicing options.

I’ve attached a redline template our Legal team prefers — will share with Sara too.

Best,
Jennifer Park
Head of Platform Partnerships, Greenline Financial
[Attachment: greenline_legal_template.docx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@greenline.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenline.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement readiness & draft MPA

Jennifer — perfect, thanks for the speed. Two quick follow-ups and commitments from our side: 

1) Vendor form & W9: I’ll get those to you by EOD today.
2) Marketplace invoicing options: brief summary in the MPA — two models:
   - Marketplace-managed billing: marketplace invoices Greenline and remits to Redwood; simple for procurement but may delay vendor-level payment reconciliations.
   - Direct vendor invoicing: Redwood invoices Greenline directly; works with Coupa and PO workflows.

Marissa (CC’d) — can you schedule a 30-min technical walkthrough for Tom and Sara next week? Prefer Thu 2026-05-21 10:00am PT or Fri 2026-05-22 9:00am PT. The goal is to cover integration touchpoints, expected token usage patterns for pilot, and any security evidence we can provide proactively.

I’ll also attach the vendor form + W9 and a short one-page marketplace note to the MPA draft.

Thanks,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_vendor_form.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@greenline.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenline.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement readiness & draft MPA

Hi Jennifer / Tom —

Happy to run the walkthrough. Confirming Thu 2026-05-21 10:00am PT works for us. Agenda (30 min):
- 10m: Integration overview & pilot scope (models, expected QPS, latency expectations)
- 10m: Security evidence we can provide immediately (SOC2 sections, network diagrams, logging/audit sample)
- 10m: Billing flow options and Coupa vendor onboarding checklist

Prep items for Greenline: list of expected production sequences (avg sequence length), primary use cases, and whether you’ll need embeddings/reranking in the pilot — that helps us size token estimates for the PO.

I’ll share a calendar invite and a short one-pager after this email.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: se_walkthrough_agenda.pdf]
